svg.aria-label: Clocks and power, how the cluster changes speed, sleeps and wakes
svg.text: Clocks and power, how the cluster changes speed, sleeps and wakes
Measured: the clock ramp and the SMC power keys. Inferred: sleep states and IPIs. The rest is read from patents; dotted outlines mark it.
cores, L2 and bus interface move together
levels inferred from the override registers
routing read from patents; IPI registers inferred from the register map
one pulse in four, no DVFS change
raised when cores stall on memory
ACC_OVRD: L2 flush, SRM and CPM off, link down
wake: restart address from the always-on manager
